lines.say: In 2008, a passenger saw baggage handlers throwing fucking guitars.
Dave Carroll owned one. It cost thirty five hundred bucks, and the bottom got smashed.
He told three United employees at the airport. Not one of them helped.
For nine months, he chased the airline over a twelve hundred dollar repair.
The answer was no. He hadn't filed a claim within twenty four hours.
So this magnificent bastard wrote a song. United Breaks Guitars.
The video hit YouTube in July 2009, and millions of people watched that shit.
Suddenly United was calling to apologize, and asking to use it for staff training.
Your clients won't write a song. They'll just quietly book somebody else.
Message Health catches who's gone quiet, and follows up before they're gone.
